The '''Shadow Tech rifle''' was an augmented type of [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]] made by the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Shadow Tech rifle appeared in the game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] in the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]] combat zone. Small holograms hidden in the zone can be collected by the players. Completing the collection of the Shadow Tech rifle rewards players with an equitable [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].
